lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical lines; spacing is wider on the anterior flank and progressively more compressed towards the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped topological split is visible at the dorsal end of the 6th stripe from the anterior, oriented towards the spinal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 4th and 9th stripes from the anterior show clear vertical discontinuities, terminating in the mid-torso region without reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5 high-contrast white spots is located on the lower posterior haunch with high localized density above the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line across the thigh.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white chevron between the eyes, white spotting on the maxillary region, and a white crescent-shaped patch on the lower throat.
